facts.text: The undergraduate University Core Curriculum at LMU is organized across three developmental levels—Foundations, Explorations, and Integrations—plus an Experiential Learning for Mission requirement.

sources.title: University Core Curriculum | Academic Bulletin
sources.quote: The LMU Core is organized across three levels – Foundations, Explorations, and Integrations.

sources.title: University Core Curriculum | Academic Bulletin
sources.quote: In addition to the above, students will also take one or multiple courses that emphasize mission-driven community engagement, referred to as Experiential Learning for Mission
